source: Chen L., Qin T., Huangfu Z., Li L., Wei W. Optimization of Flip-Landing Trajectories for Starship based on a Deep Learned Simulator. arXiv:2508.06520 (2025)
method: RANS, boundary-layer resolved grid (~4e6 points), ANSYS Fluent; incompressible (Ma < 0.3); no engine plume
configuration: Starship S31 prototype; forward flaps deployed flat; aft flaps folded upward at 80 deg; flaps fixed (no deflection sweep)

references.moment_centre: not stated explicitly; centre of mass at 0.60 L from the nose tip

digitisation.figure: Figure 2 (CFD data markers, not the neural-network curve)
digitisation.reading_error: about +/-0.15 in C_L and C_D, +/-0.08 in C_M; sign convention of alpha and C_M as plotted
digitisation.warning: Use for curve shape and zero crossings. Absolute magnitudes depend on the unstated reference area.

derived_observations: C_L crosses zero near alpha 90-95 deg for this flap set
C_D near its maximum plateau (about 4.6-5.6) for alpha 60-110 deg
C_M approaches zero from below between about 100 and 130 deg: with forward flaps flat and aft flaps folded, trim lies above 100 deg
